[TASK]
Render Reference image 1 as a finished empty late-1990s Japanese RPG derived-stat table surface. Reference image 2 is an accepted empty Qwen donor and controls the raster palette and border character. No source screenshot containing text is present in this pass.

[REFERENCE ROLE]
Reference image 1 is the mandatory empty 180 by 108 geometry guide. Reference image 2 is a Qwen-rendered blank style donor from the same Status window. Keep the guide empty and borrow only pale panel colors, hard one-pixel borders, and raster texture from the donor.

[PRESERVATION INVARIANTS]
- Keep the exact six-row 180 by 108 geometry from Reference image 1.
- Keep every row empty.
- Use Reference image 2 only for pale-blue-grey palette, hard pixel-scale borders, and subtle late-1990s raster texture.

[CANVAS AND LAYOUT]
- Return this crop only, never the complete game screenshot or magenta desktop.
- Render at exactly 720*432 pixels for point reduction back to 180 by 108.
- Continue the nearest white, pale-grey, or pale-blue panel surface through every erased foreground pixel.

[REGION EDITS]
- REGION: derived-stats
  CHANGE: Completely remove Atk Def Matk Mdef Hit Flee Critical Aspd Status Point Guild and every number punctuation and value. Leave no readable text, pseudo-text, numbers, arrows, icons, glyph fragments, shadows, or selection tint.
  PRESERVE: the two derived-stat columns, white row surfaces, thin grey separators, right edge, and lower rule; row and column boundaries; source-scale raster character

[STYLE SYSTEM]
- Exact late-1990s Japanese PC RPG raster UI inpainting
- empty source-matched panel donor

[ASSET RULES]
- No semantic foreground may remain.
- No replacement labels, controls, icons, decoration, or invented panels.

[NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS]
- No readable or gibberish text, digits, arrows, buttons, blue selection, magenta, neighboring windows, smoothing, modern UI, rounded cards, or soft shadows.
- Do not copy or redraw any text, digits, labels, values, plus signs, arrows, or icons from Reference image 1.
- No magenta edge and no semantic source screenshot is available to transcribe.

[QUALITY GATE]
- OCR at source scale returns no labels or values.
- The donor aligns with the source crop boundaries and can be composited without a seam.
- Only empty local panel and chrome surfaces remain.
- The output is semantically identical to the empty Reference 2 guide and stylistically matched to Reference 1.
